stem.zh-CN: 在[[term:self-attention|自注意力机制]]中，[[term:qkv-projection|Q、K、V 三个矩阵]]通常是通过什么方式得到的？
stem.en-US: In [[term:self-attention|self-attention]], how are the three matrices Q, K, and V usually obtained?

explanation.zh-CN: [[term:qkv-projection|Q、K、V]]通常由输入分别乘以不同的线性变换矩阵得到。
explanation.en-US: [[term:qkv-projection|Q, K, and V]] are usually obtained by multiplying the input by different linear transformation matrices.

primaryConcept.zh-CN: 自注意力中的Q/K/V线性投影

text.zh-CN: 通过[[term:rnn|循环神经网络]]生成
输入向量与三个不同的权重矩阵相乘
text.en-US: The input vector is multiplied by three different weight matrices

text.zh-CN: 随机初始化后保持不变
text.en-US: They are randomly initialized and then kept unchanged

text.zh-CN: 直接从输入向量复制得到
text.en-US: They are copied directly from the input vector
